exposure: cesarean hysterectomy for placenta accreta spectrum (PAS)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 84 consecutive patients with pathologically confirmed placenta accreta spectrum who underwent cesarean hysterectomy, compared to 42 women who had cesarean section without hysterectomy, matched for age, gravidity, and number of prior CSs.
finding: Approximately half of patients undergoing cesarean hysterectomy for PAS experienced symptoms suggestive of overactive bladder 6-30 months postoperatively, with urinary frequency being significantly more prevalent and bothersome compared to those who had cesarean section alone.
mod_finding: Urinary frequency was significantly more prevalent in women who underwent cesarean hysterectomy for PAS compared to those who had cesarean section without hysterectomy.
